title: Sobolev Regularized Score Difference Estimation in Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.18237v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Estimating the difference of two Stein's score functions is a fundamental problem in generative modeling. In particular, score differences arise naturally in transfer learning, where the score difference provides the mechanism for adapting a pre-trained model to a new target distribution, and in diffusion model-based post-training methods such as discriminator guidance. Existing estimators for score differences in these settings either lack of statistical consistency or are difficult to scale up in high-dimensions. translated_title: 扩散模型中基于Sobolev正则化的得分差异估计
translated_abstract: 摘要：估计两个Stein得分函数之间的差异是生成建模中的一个基本问题。特别是，得分差异在迁移学习中自然出现，其中得分差异提供了将预训练模型适应到新目标分布的机制，并且在基于扩散模型的后期训练方法（如判别器引导）中也扮演关键角色。现有用于这些场景的得分差异估计器要么缺乏统计一致性，要么难以在高维中扩展。我们提出了一种基于Sobolev正则化的统计一致且可扩展的得分差异估计器，该正则化在确保一致性和稳定小样本训练中起关键作用。数学上，我们建立了收敛速率$O(n^{-\frac{s-1}{d+2s-2}})$，其中$d$是维度，$s$表示底层密度的平滑度，并提供了极小极大下界。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Sobolev正则化的得分差异估计方法，既保证了统计一致性又支持高维扩展，并给出了明确的收敛速率和极小极大下界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Sobolev-regularized score difference estimator that ensures statistical consistency and scalability in high dimensions, with established convergence rates and minimax lower bounds.
